name: Category Manager for WooCommerce
author: allmassim

sections.description:
Category Manager for WooCommerce allows you to easily manage your WooCommerce product categories with a range of powerful features:
– Drag-and-drop reordering of categories for flexible organization
– Quick edit functionality to update category details instantly
– Add new categories with name, slug, description, parent category, and image
– Seamless integration with WooCommerce
– Set a default category for products with no assigned category
– Display images next to categories for better visual management
– Undo functionality with a 7-second timer to recover deleted categories
– Improved user interface and bug fixes for a smoother experience

This plugin is perfect for store owners who need an efficient way to manage numerous product categories, especially with complex parent-child relationships.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the category-manager-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Ctgry Mngr’ menu in your WordPress admin dashboard to start managing your categories.
sections.faq:
Why should I install this plugin?

Managing WooCommerce product categories is very basic and can be challenging, especially if you have a large number of categories or complex parent-child relationships. With this plugin, you can easily manage categories using drag-and-drop and instant editing features.

Does this plugin work with the latest version of WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin is tested and compatible with the latest version of WooCommerce.

Can I add images to categories?

Yes, you can upload an image for each category directly from the ‘Add New Category’ form.
